meta.title: The Future of Computation: Dr. Alessandro Curioni on the Quantum Advantage
meta.description:
The future you keep hearing about is already taking shape

At GITEX AI EUROPE, Dr. Alessandro Curioni, IBM Fellow and Director of IBM Research Zurich, shares a clear view of what comes next when AI meets quantum computing. He explains why digital systems are hitting limits, how quantum changes the rules of computation and where real advantages will start to appear sooner than many expect.

From optimisation and simulation to entirely new ways of modelling complex systems, this session connects science, industry and impact. Not hype. A roadmap.
